# NewsChannel 5

> NewsChannel 5 (WTVF) is Nashville's leading local news source providing real-time coverage of news, weather, sports, and traffic for Middle Tennessee.

NewsChannel 5 serves the Nashville and Middle Tennessee region with comprehensive coverage of local, national, and breaking news. The site features investigative journalism, weather forecasting, traffic alerts, and community-focused feature series highlighting local heroes and consumer information.

## Key Topics

- Nashville, Tennessee
- Middle Tennessee
- Local News
- Breaking News
- Investigative Journalism
- Weather & Traffic
- Phil Williams
- Kelly Broderick
- Davidson County
- Crime & Justice
- Tennessee Legislature
- Community Heroes
- Consumer Advice
- Sports Coverage
- Feel-Good News

## Breaking News & Local Coverage

- [Local News](https://www.newschannel5.com/news/local-news): Local news coverage for Nashville and Davidson County from NewsChannel 5
- [National News](https://www.newschannel5.com/news/national-news): National news aggregation and breaking headlines from Scripps News

## Real-Time Information & Alerts

- [Weather](https://www.newschannel5.com/weather): Live weather forecast and radar for Nashville and Middle Tennessee
- [Traffic](https://www.newschannel5.com/traffic): Traffic alerts and road closures for Nashville and Middle Tennessee
- [Safe Places](https://www.newschannel5.com/weather/safe-places): Severe weather safety resources and shelter program information

## Sports & Entertainment

- [Sports](https://www.newschannel5.com/sports): Tennessee Titans, Nashville Predators, and local sports coverage

## Investigative Journalism

- [NewsChannel 5 Investigates](https://www.newschannel5.com/news/newschannel-5-investigates): In-depth investigations into government, crime, and consumer issues
- [Capitol Hill Investigations](https://www.newschannel5.com/news/newschannel-5-investigates/capitol-hill): Investigative coverage of corruption and scandal in Tennessee Legislature
- [Broken](https://www.newschannel5.com/news/newschannel-5-investigates/broken): Investigation into Tennessee's juvenile justice system and youth crime
- [Broken - Mental Health Crisis](https://www.newschannel5.com/news/newschannel-5-investigates/broken-mental-health-crisis): Investigation into mental health crisis in Tennessee jail system

## Community & Lifestyle Features

- [My Hero](https://www.newschannel5.com/news/my-hero): Weekly profiles of community heroes and acts of kindness in Middle Tennessee
- [Let Me Help](https://www.newschannel5.com/news/let-me-help): Consumer advice column with expert tips on health, finance, and lifestyle
- [School Patrol](https://www.newschannel5.com/news/education/school-patrol): Weekly school feature series highlighting Nashville-area student achievements
- [Price Tracker](https://www.newschannel5.com/news/your-money): Weekly price tracker for groceries and gas across Middle Tennessee
- [Take Time to Smile](https://www.newschannel5.com/news/take-time-to-smile): Thursday feel-good profiles of inspiring community members in Middle Tennessee

## Travel & Lifestyle

- [Adventures in Iceland](https://www.newschannel5.com/news/local-news/adventures-in-iceland): Travel feature series about Iceland with local Nashville personalities
